title: Control a Norwegian forest cat, cause chaos
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
I've been working on this for a while now and it's gotten to a place I feel like I can start sharing more and perhaps get a few players!

I've used a variety of ai workflows to create this. Happy to answer questions but most importantly hope this game brings a bit of joy to you all.

[catgame.io](http://catgame.io)

comments.author: katatonicmango
comments.body: FINALLY. Haha, so excited to play this later.

replies.author: Brave-History-6502
replies.body: Agree — fluid animation is incredibly hard with ai.. need to hire an animator I think but don’t have funds for that right now!

replies.author: Only-Cheetah-9579
replies.body: You could learn to do it. good animations are a selling point and what you have is not far off, just need to be tuned more

comments.author: Brave-History-6502
comments.body: Also for anyone who wants to provide feedback or testing happy to provide access to all the levels. Dm me

comments.author: Raqnarock
comments.body: That was kind of fun, good thing there is a meow button. I think the jumping on things is not entirely smooth right now and the text/descriptions can be a bit confusing sometimes. I like that it is a Norwegian forest cat.

replies.author: Brave-History-6502
replies.body: Thanks for trying! Are you from Norway? I’ve loved Norwegian forest cats since visiting my wife’s dad there.

replies.author: Raqnarock
replies.body: Hah no I am from across the other side of the North Sea. I remember getting a book years ago about cats and the Norwegian forest cats looked nice, were said to be very intelligent and the Vikings used them as companionship. Also there were rumors about that a puma escaped in the area and it made the news but it turned out to be a Norwegian forest cat. :D

comments.author: Low_Imagination_9670
comments.body:
yo this looks awesome

would you publish it on [https://pwned.games](https://pwned.games/)? how big is the game?

I'm working on it as we speak as well, looking to go live with alpha in a week or so, with proper marketing

comments.author: Ukawok92
comments.body:
Cool concept, needs a lot of work.

Cat animations are stiff, the toilet paper doesn't roll out cleanly (just generated random TP on the ground), there is a visual glitch with the putting area.

Keep working on it and you could have something cool.

replies.author: Brave-History-6502
replies.body: Give the game a try too, and let me know what feedback you have. The visual glitch on the putting is a feature so the cat is always visible in the game

comments.author: kopko222
comments.body: Add 4 player multiplayer. People playing as cats causing trouble, getting points and add "human" NPCs roaming the home and whoever gets caught takes the blame for the stuff and loses points. Simple, competitive, fun with friends. If you wish to take it to the next level, that is.
